info.title: mdu
info.description: Commandline Tool to lint and render a Markdown based documentation

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Lint, render, and manage Markdown documentation.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Runs the linter and prints the results.

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Include hidden files and folders. [default: True]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root folder containing Markdown files. Defaults to ./docs or ./Docs.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Renders Markdown files to a static HTML site.

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Include hidden files and folders. [default: True]

options.name: --editPageRoot
options.description: URL to the root URL for editing the source files. [default: ]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root folder containing Markdown files. Defaults to ./docs or ./Docs.

arguments.name: OUTPATH
arguments.description: Output folder for rendered files. Defaults to ./site.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Renders, serves, and watches a Markdown site.

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Include hidden files and folders. [default: True]

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Do not open the preview in a browser. [default: False]

options.name: --editPageRoot
options.description: URL to the root URL for editing the source files. [default: ]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root folder containing the Markdown files. Defaults to ./docs or ./Docs.

arguments.name: OUTPATH
arguments.description: Output folder for the rendered site. Defaults to ./site.

commands.name: tree
commands.description: Prints the detected Markdown files as a tree.

options.name: --hidden
options.description: Include hidden files and folders. [default: True]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Root folder containing Markdown files. Defaults to ./docs or ./Docs.
